source.scope_basis: The open issue supplies only its title. Coverage therefore checks the two documented start routes without assigning an undocumented cause.

routes.setup: Create distinct notes on steps 1, 2, 3 and 4 through the grid, then press Play.
routes.oracle: The complete MIDI stream must begin 60,62 and continue 64,65 over three cycles plus the next step 1. Exact sequence equality rejects a missing or duplicated step 1 before step 2.

routes.setup: Select the MIDI clock source, warm its 24 PPQN estimator, then deliver Start before or with the next Clock; repeat Start during playback in the interaction case.
routes.oracle: M-SYNC-001 requires the step 1 note exactly at the first post-Start Clock and step 2 six pulses later across four Start phases. M-SYNC-006 requires the same single step 1 restart while already playing, after release of the held pre-restart note.

issues.title: Scale page trig locks do not appear when channel page is on memory screen

source.scope_basis: The issue requests visible channel scale-lock indication on the Memory page. The grid marker is characterised because the manual promises retained lock actions and scale locks, but does not specify this page's LED level.

routes.setup: Create a channel scale lock on step 3 through the held-step plus scale-slot grid gesture, then navigate to Memory.
routes.oracle: The locked step blinks at level 12 while an unlocked neighboring trig remains at 15; the Trig Locks page independently confirms that the lock exists.

issues.production_change: Memory-page indicator predicate includes channel scale locks

issues.title: nb parameter trig locks crash playback: undefined channel c in step.process_params

source.scope_basis: The issue identifies the undefined channel variable on the n.b. parameter-lock playback path.

routes.setup: Assign a Doubledecker n.b. parameter, place a lock on a step through the grid, then play across it in the n.b.-audio runtime profile.
routes.oracle: Playback reaches and leaves the locked step without a Lua error; focused integration tests verify application and restoration with independent channel state.

issues.production_change: step.process_params uses channel.number for norns parameter state
